verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents both an official MCP server and a CLI that let an AI client create and manage flags, with scopable API tokens. Its Approvals feature, however, is evidenced only as an option to request approval, not as an enforced gate that blocks unreviewed agent writes to production. missing for 10: evidence that approvals can be made mandatory per environment (e.g. production), evidence that approval requirements apply to API/CLI/MCP-originated changes, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent flag workflows.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can create and toggle flags through documented APIs, CLIs, or MCP — and the platform can force my changes through approval workflows instead of letting me write to production unreviewed
